name: api-doc

api.iface.description: Inline reference to a TypeScript interface or type alias defined in the SNL-Basics API. Renders in \texttt{} with a cyan tint.

api.class.description: Inline reference to a TypeScript class in the SNL-Basics API. Renders in \texttt{} with a teal tint.

api.field.description: Inline reference to a Class's field (data or method member). Renders in \texttt{} with a lime tint.

api.fn.description: Inline reference to a function or method exported by SNL-Basics. Renders in \texttt{} with an orange tint.

api.const.description: Inline reference to an exported constant / default-instance / value in SNL-Basics. Renders in \texttt{} with an amber tint.

api.prop.description: Inline reference to a React component prop. Renders in \texttt{} with a rose tint.

api.comp.description: Inline reference to a React component. Renders in \texttt{} with a pink tint.

api.mod.description: Inline reference to a source-tree module / namespace. Renders in \texttt{} with an indigo tint.

api.pkg.description: Inline reference to an npm package or distribution unit. Renders in \texttt{} with a violet tint.

api.concept.description: Inline reference to a cross-cutting concept (surface, stability level, consumer, distribution decision). Renders in \texttt{} with a neutral tint.

api.kw.description: Inline lowercase keyword or built-in term (macro, kind, envMode, template, ...). Renders in \texttt{} with a neutral gray, no strong color — these are common vocabulary, not linked artefacts.

api.file.description: Inline reference to a source file or workspace-relative path. Renders in \texttt{} with a cyan tint.

api.code.description: Inline monospace fallback for arbitrary code snippets (e.g. \forall, `dist-lib/index.js`). No color; use when no other kind fits.

api.slash.description: Variadic connector macro — joins children with ' / '. Used to sew inline API-term references into readable prose without leaving formula mode boundaries.

api.plus.description: Variadic connector macro — joins children with ' + '. Used to sew inline API-term references into readable prose without leaving formula mode boundaries.

api.arrow.description: Variadic connector macro — joins children with ' → '. Used to sew inline API-term references into readable prose without leaving formula mode boundaries.

api.list.description: Variadic connector macro — joins children with '、'. Used to sew inline API-term references into readable prose without leaving formula mode boundaries.

api.para.description: One paragraph of prose. Variadic in the number of inline items. Renders as a text-mode block; every entry's content.snl uses `api.para` as its ROOT single macro tree (SNL grammar requirement). Multi-paragraph entries chain paragraphs via literal newlines inside the para text, or nest a second para as the last child.

SnlSyntaxTreeParseOptions.description: Options for parsing an SNL fragment.

SnlSyntaxTreeParseOptions.activeBinderId.description: Binder names already active outside the parsed fragment.

description: Term macros for the SNL-Basics dogfood API doc (Phase 2). Inline-term references (api.iface, api.fn, api.class, api.const, api.prop, api.comp, api.mod, api.pkg, api.concept, api.kw, api.file, api.code), connector punctuation (api.slash, api.plus, api.arrow, api.list), and one structural macro (api.para) for prose paragraphs.
